ko.B: 여러분은 모든 면에서 부요하게 되어 모든 면에서 너그러울 수 있을 것입니다. 그리고 우리가 전하는 여러분의 너그러움은 하나님께 감사를 드리게 할 것입니다. \v 12 이 돕는 일, 곧 거룩한 섬김은 성도들에게 부족한 것을 채울 뿐만 아니라, 하나님께 드리는 많은 감사로 넘쳐흐릅니다. \v 13 이 돕는 일은 여러분이 어떤 사람인지 보여 줄 것이고, 그들은 그것 때문에 하나님께 영광을 돌릴 것입니다. 여러분이 고백하는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 복음에 여러분이 순종하는 것과, 그들과 모든 사람과 함께 나누는 여러분의 너그러움 때문입니다. \v 14 그리고 그들은 여러분을 위해 기도할 때 여러분을 그리워할 것입니다. 여러분 위에 머무는 하나님의 넘치는 은혜 때문입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 여러분을 모든 면에서 부요하게 하셔서 여러분이 언제나 너그럽게 줄 수 있게 하실 것입니다. 그러면 우리가 여러분의 선물을 하나님의 백성에게 전할 때, 그들이 그것 때문에 하나님께 감사할 것입니다. \v 12 이 돕는 일은 하나님을 섬기는 일이고, 제사장이 하는 일과 같습니다. 이 일은 하나님의 백성에게 필요한 것을 줍니다. 그러나 그것으로 끝나지 않습니다. 이 일은 많은 사람이 하나님께 감사하게 합니다. \v 13 여러분이 주는 도움은 여러분의 믿음이 참되다는 것을 증명할 것입니다. 그래서 그들은 하나님께 영광을 돌릴 것입니다. 여러분이 공개적으로 고백하는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}에 대한 기쁜 소식에 여러분이 순종하기 때문이고, 여러분이 그들과 모든 사람과 아주 너그럽게 나누기 때문입니다. \v 14 그들은 여러분을 위해 기도할 것이고, 여러분을 보고 싶어 할 것입니다. 하나님께서 여러분에게 주신 은혜가 그토록 크기 때문입니다.

pt.L: [Vocês serão] enriquecidos em tudo para toda generosidade, a qual, por meio de nós, produz ação de graças a Deus; \v 12 porque o ministério deste serviço não só supre as necessidades dos santos, mas também transborda em muitas ações de graças a Deus; \v 13 pela prova deste ministério, [eles] glorificam a Deus pela submissão da confissão de vocês ao evangelho {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} e pela generosidade da [sua] comunhão com eles e com todos, \v 14 e [pela] oração deles por vocês, [enquanto] sentem saudade de vocês por causa da extraordinária graça de Deus sobre vocês.
pt.B: Vocês serão enriquecidos de todas as formas para serem generosos de todas as formas, e a generosidade de vocês, levada por nós, produzirá ação de graças a Deus. \v 12 Pois este socorro, um serviço sagrado, não só supre o que falta ao povo santo de Deus, mas também transborda em muitas ações de graças a Deus. \v 13 Este socorro vai mostrar quem vocês são, e eles darão glória a Deus por isso: pela maneira como vocês se submetem ao evangelho {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} que confessam, e pela generosidade da parceria de vocês com eles e com todos. \v 14 E, quando orarem por vocês, sentirão saudade de vocês, por causa da extraordinária graça de Deus que está sobre vocês.
pt.R: Deus vai fazer vocês ricos de todas as formas, para que vocês possam sempre dar com generosidade. Então, quando levarmos a oferta de vocês ao povo de Deus, eles vão agradecer a Deus por ela. \v 12 Esta ajuda é um serviço a Deus, como o trabalho de um sacerdote. Ela dá ao povo de Deus aquilo de que eles precisam. Mas faz mais do que isso. Faz muitas pessoas agradecerem a Deus. \v 13 A ajuda que vocês dão vai provar que a fé de vocês é verdadeira. Por isso eles vão dar glória a Deus, porque vocês obedecem às boas-novas a respeito de {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} que confessam abertamente, e porque vocês compartilham com tanta generosidade com eles e com todos. \v 14 Eles vão orar por vocês e vão querer muito ver vocês, porque a graça de Deus para com vocês é muito grande.

decisions.choice: "being enriched": a loose participle that carries on the promise of verse 8
decisions.reason: πλουτιζόμενοι has no main verb to hang on. It most naturally goes back to "you" in verse 8, with verses 9-10 as an aside: God will make them rich in every way. The riches are for generosity, not for keeping, as in 8:9.

decisions.choice: generosity: wholehearted, open-handed giving
decisions.reason: As in 8:2, ἁπλότητα is singleness of heart that gives without holding back or calculating. It comes again in verse 13.

decisions.choice: through us: through Paul and those who carry the gift to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: δι ἡμῶν means that Paul's part in collecting and delivering the gift (8:19-20) is the channel through which the Corinthians' generosity becomes thanks to God from the believers in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: the collection for the poor believers in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: διακονία and διακονίας are the relief fund, as in verse 1 and 8:4. "The holy ones" are the believers in Jerusalem (Romans 15:25-26).

decisions.choice: service: a service done for the community and offered to God, with a priestly overtone
decisions.reason: λειτουργίας was used for public services that a citizen paid for, and in the Greek Old Testament for the priests' service in the tabernacle and temple. Paul uses the word family of the Philippians' gift (Philippians 2:17, 25, 30) and of Gentiles sharing material help with Jerusalem (Romans 15:27). The collection is practical help, but it is also an offering made to God, and it ends in worship.

decisions.choice: proof: what the relief shows the Corinthians to be
alternatives: a test still to be passed
decisions.reason: δοκιμῆς is the quality that testing brings to light, as in 2:9 and 8:2. The relief proves that their love and faith are genuine (8:8, 24).

decisions.choice: the subject of "glorifying": the believers in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: δοξάζοντες is another loose participle. Those who give glory to God are the holy ones whose needs are met (verse 12), who will pray for the Corinthians (verse 14).

decisions.choice: the obedience that goes with confessing the gospel of Christ
decisions.reason: ὑποταγῇ is submission or obedience, and ὁμολογίας the confession or open declaration of faith. The phrase means that their obedience matches what they confess: they acknowledge the gospel of Christ and live it out by giving. The Jerusalem believers will see that the Gentile churches' faith is real.

decisions.choice: the collection binds Gentile and Jewish believers together
decisions.reason: κοινωνίας is the partnership word of 8:4 and Philippians 1:5: sharing in a common life and work. Paul hoped the gift would show the believers in Jerusalem that the Gentile churches belonged with them (Romans 15:25-31). "With all" widens the partnership beyond Jerusalem to all believers, or to all people.

decisions.choice: their prayer and longing are the Jerusalem believers' response
alternatives: Jerusalem's prayer is a second ground of thanks to God
decisions.reason: The words are loosely joined to what goes before, most likely as a further result: the receivers will not only praise God but pray for the givers and long for them. Gift and prayer flow in both directions.

decisions.choice: the surpassing grace of God in the Corinthians: the passage ends where it began
decisions.reason: χάριν is God's grace, as in 8:1, where it was given to the Macedonians. Now the believers in Jerusalem will see the same grace at work in the Corinthians. ὑπερβάλλουσαν means going beyond measure (3:10).

decisions.choice: ministry (L); relief (B); helping, help (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice for the collection, as in verse 1 and 8:4 (m4).

decisions.choice: service (L); a sacred service (B); a service to God, like the work of a priest (R)
decisions.reason: Literal says "service". Balanced adds "sacred" and Readable compares it with a priest's work, so that the reader hears the overtone of worship in the word (m5).

decisions.choice: holy ones (L); God's holy people (B); God's people (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering of this word.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article.

decisions.choice: submission of your confession to the gospel (L); the way you submit to the gospel ... that you confess (B); you obey the good news ... that you openly confess (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek phrase; Balanced and Readable say how obedience and confession belong together (m8).

decisions.choice: sharing (L); partnership (B); share (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "partnership", the word chosen for this noun in 8:4 and in Philippians (m9).

decisions.choice: when we take your gift to God's people, they will thank God; prove that your faith is real
alternatives: through us thanksgiving to God; the proof
decisions.reason: Readable says how the thanks comes about (m3) and what the proof shows (m6).

decisions.choice: carried by us
decisions.reason: Balanced says how Paul's part makes the gift into thanks (m3).

decisions.choice: l’action de grâce, les actions de grâce (L, B); remercier (R)
decisions.reason: "Action de grâce" is the ordinary French phrase for thanks given to God, and it lets the reader hear the grace of verses 8 and 14 in the thanks it produces, as Paul's Greek does. Readable uses the everyday verb.

decisions.choice: [votre] partage (L); vous êtes solidaires (B)
decisions.reason: "Communion" would suggest the Lord's Supper to many readers, and "partenariat" is business language; Literal says "partage", as the English says "sharing", and Balanced gives the sense of the English "partnership" (m9) with "solidaires".

decisions.choice: comunión (L); la generosidad con que comparten (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "comunión", the traditional word for a shared life and a shared work; Balanced and Readable say plainly what the sharing is here, giving to the believers in Jerusalem (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: [mientras] los añoran
decisions.reason: The Greek participle "longing for you" cannot take a ustedes/vosotros setting as one Spanish word, so Literal writes it as a clause with a supplied "mientras".

decisions.choice: utumishi (L); huduma takatifu (B); huduma kwa Mungu, kama kazi ya kuhani (R)
decisions.reason: This second word is a service offered to God, with a priestly overtone (meaning decision). Literal says "utumishi" (service) to keep it apart from "huduma" (ministry), the first word; Balanced says "huduma takatifu" (sacred service) and Readable explains it as the English Readable does. "Ibada" would be heard as a worship service.

decisions.choice: uthibitisho
decisions.reason: "Uthibitisho" (proof) comes from "-thibitika", the root used for this word family in 2:9, so the link can be traced.

decisions.choice: "công việc phụng sự" (L); "một công việc phục vụ thánh" (B); "một công việc phục vụ Đức Chúa Trời, như công việc của thầy tế lễ" (R) for leitourgia
decisions.reason: The word carries a priestly overtone (m5): "phụng sự" is the word of the Vietnamese Romans 1:9 for serving God, and Balanced and Readable say it is sacred, as the English does. "Sự phục vụ" (L), "việc cứu trợ" (B), "việc giúp đỡ" (R) stay for diakonia, as in 8:4.

decisions.choice: "sự chia sẻ" (L); "sự chung phần" (B) for koinonia here
decisions.reason: Here koinonia is sharing in the gift with them (m9); the Literal word of 1:9 in the first letter, "thông công", would sound like a church meeting.

decisions.choice: "이 섬김의 일" (L); "이 돕는 일, 곧 거룩한 섬김" (B); "하나님을 섬기는 일 ... 제사장이 하는 일과 같습니다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the second word as a service offered to God with a priestly overtone; "섬김" is its word in Philippians 2:17 and 2:30, and the first word is the collection, as in verse 1.

decisions.choice: "너그러움" (L, B), "너그럽게" (R)
decisions.reason: As at 8:2.

decisions.choice: "[여러분은]" (v.11) and "[그들은]" (v.13) in Literal
decisions.reason: The meaning decisions read both participles as loose: the first goes back to "you" in verse 8, the second has the believers in Jerusalem as subject.

decisions.choice: "함께 나누다" at every level
decisions.reason: The word of 1 Corinthians 10:16 (B); the meaning decision reads it as partnership with them and with all.

decisions.choice: "고백하고 순종하는 것" (L); "고백하는 ... 복음에 순종하는 것" (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase as the obedience that goes with confessing the gospel; a Korean noun phrase would be unclear.

decisions.choice: ação de graças, ações de graças
decisions.reason: The usual Portuguese for thanksgiving to God is built on "graças", so the link Paul makes between God's grace and the thanks it produces (verse 14; 8:1; 9:15) stays audible in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: saudade
decisions.reason: As in 7:7 and 7:11, "sentir saudade" is the Portuguese for longing for people one is apart from (m10); Readable says plainly that they will want to see the Corinthians.

source.text: χάρις τῷ θεῷ ἐπὶ τῇ ἀνεκδιηγήτῳ αὐτοῦ δωρεᾷ.

records.literal_gloss: Thanks to the God for the indescribable of him gift.

en.L: Thanks [be] to God for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} gift that cannot be told in full.
en.B: Thanks be to God for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} gift, which no words can describe!
en.R: We thank God for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} gift. It is too wonderful for words!

fr.L: Grâce [soit rendue] à Dieu pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} don qu’on ne peut pas décrire entièrement.
fr.B: Grâce soit rendue à Dieu pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} don, qu’aucune parole ne peut décrire !
fr.R: Nous remercions Dieu pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} don. Ce don est plus merveilleux que tout ce que les mots peuvent dire !

es.L: Gracias [sean] a Dios por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} don indescriptible.
es.B: ¡Gracias a Dios por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} don, que no hay palabras para describir!
es.R: Damos gracias a Dios por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} regalo. ¡Es tan maravilloso que no hay palabras para describirlo!

sw.L: Shukrani [ziwe] kwa Mungu kwa ajili ya zawadi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} isiyoweza kuelezwa kikamilifu.
sw.B: Mungu ashukuriwe kwa zawadi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ambayo hakuna maneno yanayoweza kuieleza!
sw.R: Tunamshukuru Mungu kwa zawadi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Ni ya ajabu mno, maneno hayatoshi kuieleza!

vi.L: Tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời vì món quà không thể tả xiết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời về món quà của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là món quà không lời nào tả được!
vi.R: Chúng ta cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời về món quà của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Món quà ấy tuyệt vời không lời nào nói hết!

ko.L: 말로 다 할 수 없는 그분의 선물로 인해 하나님께 감사합니다.
ko.B: 말로는 다 표현할 수 없는 그분의 선물로 인해 하나님께 감사합니다!
ko.R: 우리는 하나님께서 주신 선물 때문에 하나님께 감사합니다. 그 선물은 말로 다 할 수 없을 만큼 놀랍습니다!

pt.L: Graças [sejam dadas] a Deus pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} dom que não se pode descrever por completo.
pt.B: Graças a Deus pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} dom, que nenhuma palavra consegue descrever!
pt.R: Damos graças a Deus pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} presente. É um presente maravilhoso demais para caber em palavras!

decisions.choice: thanks: gratitude given to God
decisions.reason: χάρις with "to God" and no verb is the set phrase for giving thanks, as in 2:14 and 8:16. It closes Paul's play on the word through chapters 8-9: the grace God gives (8:1; 9:8, 14) produces generous gifts and returns to him as thanks.

decisions.choice: God's gift: his gift of himself in Christ, from which all this giving flows
alternatives: the grace at work in the collection and the unity it brings
decisions.reason: δωρεᾷ is a free gift. Paul most likely means the gift of Christ, who became poor so that they might become rich (8:9), the source of all the grace in these chapters. Some take it as the grace shown in the collection itself and the bond it makes between Gentile and Jewish believers; the two belong together.

decisions.choice: beyond description: more than words can fully tell
